info.description: The Selenit Recliner Detail Submission API facilitates the addition of detailed product information for the Selenit recliner. This endpoint allows users to submit essential attributes and specifications, ensuring that all aspects of the product are accurately represented in the catalog. Typically used by product managers and inventory managers, it helps maintain up-to-date product details, thus enhancing the browsing experience for customers. Submit detailed descriptions, dimensions, and features of the Selenit recliner to improve product visibility and market relevance.
